summary: Iteration 5: Tested credential types (user_password, token, ssh_key), verification endpoints, Direct Interaction Plugin v1.1.0 with SMB, and AuthenticationFailureException. Fixed critical database schema issue where domain and username columns were NOT NULL but should be nullable for non-user_password credential types.

fixed.issue: Database schema mismatch - domain and username columns had NOT NULL constraint preventing token and ssh_key credential types from being created
fixed.fix: Created alembic migration a1b2c3d4e5f6 to make domain and username columns nullable

fixed.issue: Cache method signature mismatch in direct_interaction.py - was using sync cache.get(key) but PluginCache.get() requires async await cache.get(operation, params)
fixed.fix: Updated resolve_hostname, list_shares, and list_directory methods to use correct async cache API

backend: test_create_user_password_credential_full - Creates user_password credential with all fields
test_create_user_password_with_ntlm_only - Creates credential with NTLM hash only (no password)
test_create_user_password_missing_username_fails - Validation requires username for user_password type
test_create_token_credential_full - Creates token credential with all fields
test_create_token_without_name - Name field is optional for token type
test_create_ssh_key_credential_full - Creates ssh_key credential with all fields
test_create_ssh_key_without_passphrase - Passphrase is optional for ssh_key type
test_verify_credential_and_check_via_get - Verification status persists in database
test_plugin_version_is_1_1_0 - Direct Interaction plugin version is 1.1.0
test_by_type_endpoint_filters_correctly - Plugin credential filter uses by-type endpoint
test_plugin_exceptions_endpoint_exists - Plugin loads without exception errors

Plugin page shows SMB functionalities as 'Implementado'
